_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five industry groups with record bookings ($71.7B in FY22); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30 and already repricing obvious losers (Chegg, 2023-05-02), but the sell-side read for ACN was share gain (J.P.Morgan, 2023-02-10) and the stock trades at 26.7x FY23E — a premium, not an AI discount. Re-file under DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only when the multiple starts discounting the legacy-services deflation J.P.Morgan describes, or it shows up in managed-services growth.

Live: Accenture's own FY2022 10-K says 'Examples of areas of significant change include digital-, cloud- and security-related offerings, which are continually evolving, as well as developments in areas such as artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, automation, blockchain, Internet of Things, quantum and edge computing, infrastructure and network engineering, intelligent connected products, digital engineering and manufacturing, and robotics solutions. ... Some of these technological developments have reduced and replaced some of our historical services and solutions and may continue to do so in the future.' At the same time it reports 'growing demand to assist clients with application modernization and maintenance, cloud enablement and managed security services'. The stock trades at 26.7x FY23E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of ACN's outsourcing specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five industry groups with record bookings ($71.7B in FY22); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.58x; +48% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.22; conservative 2yr -7%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY12-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.5%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (FY12-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +19.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-06-30) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.58x (33.6% downside to Bear $205 / +21.2% upside to Bull $374) | Adj composite 1.98 vs market 3.20: gap -1.22 [OVERVALUED] | +48% above the EPP floor $208 (18x FY23E $11.57) | Conservative 2-yr case: -6.8% total (-3.4%/yr) | At 26.7x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $408 sits above the BULL case; consulting -1% LC in Q3, Q4 guided +2-6% LC; GenAI is a live theme, read by the sell side as share gain for consultancies, not a threat.
